description:
Decode PX4 EVENT messages using local or automatically acquired metadata.
Automatic acquisition reuses validated cached files before downloading over FTP.
Core sys_status raw event logging and publication remain unchanged.

parameters.name: event_decoding_mode
parameters.description: PX4 event logging: auto (default), local, or disabled; changes require restart.

parameters.name: event_metadata_file
parameters.description: Firmware-matching local JSON or JSON.xz definitions; valid only in local mode.

parameters.name: event_metadata_download_delay
parameters.description: Automatic metadata download delay from FCU connection, in seconds.

parameters.name: event_metadata_cache_enabled
parameters.description: Reuse validated persistent definitions in automatic mode.

parameters.name: event_metadata_cache_dir
parameters.description: Empty selects $HOME/.cache/mavros/px4_events; otherwise use this directory.

parameters.name: event_metadata_cache_max_bytes
parameters.description: Best-effort finalized cache size limit; nonpositive values disable persistence.
